pokemon_scp.name: Cloyster
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0091 is to be contained in a deep cold-water vault with reinforced shell integrity scanners. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0091’s shell spikes.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0091 possesses a shell capable of withstanding extreme force. Internal organism remains unseen, but emits freezing mist capable of immobilizing targets. Shell spikes show anomalous sharpness.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when disturbed. Shell closes rapidly with crushing force.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0091-A: SCP-0091’s shell resisted a 20-ton hydraulic press.
Addendum 0091-B: Freezing mist formed crystalline patterns resembling fractal ice.

pokemon_scp.name: Gastly
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0092 is to be contained in a negative-pressure spectral chamber with toxin scrubbers. Personnel must avoid inhaling SCP-0092’s gaseous form.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0092 is a gaseous spectral organism capable of phasing through solid matter. Gas composition includes hallucinogenic compounds that induce fear responses.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Mischievous and unpredictable. Frequently attempts to startle personnel.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0092-A: SCP-0092 induced mass hallucinations during a containment drill.
Addendum 0092-B: Gas samples show partial ectoplasmic composition.

pokemon_scp.name: Haunter
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0093 is to be contained in a reinforced spectral vault with anti-ectoplasmic barriers. Personnel must not allow SCP-0093 to make physical contact.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0093 possesses floating appendages capable of inducing paralysis through touch. Displays advanced phasing abilities and can bypass most physical barriers.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and predatory. Attempts to approach personnel from blind angles.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0093-A: SCP-0093 phased through a triple-layer barrier.
Addendum 0093-B: Paralysis induced by SCP-0093 lasted over 40 minutes.

pokemon_scp.name: Gengar
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0094 cannot be reliably contained. Partial containment relies on spectral dampeners and negotiation protocols. Personnel must avoid direct eye contact.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0094 is a highly advanced spectral organism capable of manipulating shadows, inducing fear hallucinations, and phasing through any known material. Displays intelligence comparable to humans and awareness of containment strategies.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Playful but malicious. Appears to enjoy psychological manipulation.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0094-A: SCP-0094 extinguished all lights in its containment wing simultaneously.
Addendum 0094-B: SCP-0094 claims to perceive 'the space between thoughts'.

pokemon_scp.name: Onix
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0095 is to be contained in a titan-grade geological vault with seismic dampeners. Personnel must avoid standing near SCP-0095’s burrowing path.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0095 is a massive serpentine rock organism capable of burrowing through reinforced concrete. Body segments show anomalous density and emit faint vibrations.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when disturbed. Burrowing generates seismic shockwaves.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0095-A: SCP-0095 tunneled through reinforced substrate in under 30 seconds.
Addendum 0095-B: Vibrational patterns resemble low-frequency communication.

pokemon_scp.name: Drowzee
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0096 is to be contained in a psychic-dampened chamber. Personnel must avoid falling asleep near SCP-0096.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0096 feeds on dream energy and can induce sleep in nearby organisms. Prolonged exposure causes vivid nightmares.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm but unsettling. Frequently attempts to approach sleeping personnel.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0096-A: SCP-0096 induced sleep in a guard through a sealed barrier.
Addendum 0096-B: Dream energy readings spike during REM cycles.

pokemon_scp.name: Hypno
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0097 is to be contained in a reinforced psychic vault with triple-layer dampeners. Personnel must not allow SCP-0097 to use its pendulum.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0097 can induce deep hypnosis and manipulate memories. Pendulum emits low-frequency pulses that bypass cognitive shielding.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Predatory and manipulative. Shows interest in vulnerable personnel.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0097-A: SCP-0097 erased 12 minutes of memory from a researcher.
Addendum 0097-B: Pendulum pulses caused mass disorientation during a breach drill.

pokemon_scp.name: Krabby
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0098 is to be contained in a shallow aquatic enclosure with reinforced glass. Personnel may interact with SCP-0098 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0098 is a small crustacean organism with powerful pincers capable of cracking reinforced plastic. Displays mild hydrokinesis.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when startled. Frequently snaps pincers at moving objects.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0098-A: SCP-0098 cracked a containment panel during feeding.
Addendum 0098-B: Hydrokinesis appears limited to small water volumes.

pokemon_scp.name: Kingler
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0099 is to be contained in a reinforced aquatic vault with shock-resistant walls. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0099’s oversized claw.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0099 possesses a massive claw capable of generating shockwaves strong enough to fracture reinforced barriers. Displays advanced hydrokinesis.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and territorial. Uses claw to intimidate and attack.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0099-A: SCP-0099 shattered a reinforced barrier with a claw strike.
Addendum 0099-B: Hydrokinesis output increases when SCP-0099 is agitated.

pokemon_scp.name: Voltorb
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0100 is to be contained in an insulated vault with shock-dampening foam and remote manipulation tools. Personnel must not physically interact with SCP-0100.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0100 is a spherical organism resembling a metallic capacitor. It can self-detonate with explosive force equivalent to industrial-grade charges. Detonation leaves behind electromagnetic residue.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Extremely volatile. Detonates when startled or threatened.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0100-A: SCP-0100 detonated during a containment scan, destroying equipment.
Addendum 0100-B: EM residue shows anomalous fractal patterns.
